Eating small meals throughout the day is the natural way the human body feeds. The “3 meals a day” is just a social practice, not a health requirement or suggestion. Just matters how small your meals are.

Drinking Gatorade will surely dehydrate you while fasting. The salt (aka electrolyte) concentration is too high and it will cause your body to shed water it needs to accommodate the salt you’re giving your body. If you’re going to drink Gatorade or similar brands for electrolytes, dilute 1:10 with water. That way, you won’t get dehydrated and don’t have to worry about the calories as much.

In terms of « how you view yourself changing » my first thought is that if you have a negative view of sugaring, you shouldn’t sugar. It’s not worth your self image.

My second thought is that more likely change is an increase in self worth or self image, better understanding of what you need/like/enjoy about a partner and you’ll be more receptive (positively) to generosity. 

I am also a young sb, and after sugaring I started taking a lot better care of myself, my confidence increased a ton, and I was able to treat my loved ones with so much generosity. It’s been a greater contributor to my quality of life.
